_what: Winter Wrap Up day-plan rows (W2-SEAS-I 2026-11-08), in the world/life/day/day_tables.json format. They roll only while the town calendar's winter_wrap_up row is in its window (when.event), use existing handlers and poses only (go_to standing, tend's watering, joyride's flight), and belong in the seasonal table (world/life/day/tables/seasonal.json, W2-SEAS-H) once the planner loads extra tables. Earth ponies get their gardens ready, pegasi clear the winter clouds, everypony clears snow around town, Fluttershy wakes the animals.
